name: Payments & Billing
description: Payments & Billing standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when CAP-PAYMENT applies.

rules.title: Treat payment state as a durable state machine
rules.detail: Define initiated/pending/authorized/captured/failed/cancelled/refunded or provider-specific mapped states and allowed transitions explicitly.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Treat payment state as a durable state machine.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Treat payment state as a durable state machine.

rules.title: Use idempotency for payment creation and capture
rules.detail: Client retries, callback retries and network ambiguity must not create duplicate charges or duplicate business fulfillment.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Use idempotency for payment creation and capture.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Use idempotency for payment creation and capture.

rules.title: Never store raw card secrets unless the system is explicitly certified to do so
rules.detail: Prefer tokenized hosted/payment-provider flows and keep sensitive payment data outside application storage/logs.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Never store raw card secrets unless the system is explicitly certified to do so.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Never store raw card secrets unless the system is explicitly certified to do so.

rules.title: Verify provider callbacks and reconcile asynchronously
rules.detail: Authenticate webhook signatures, deduplicate events and reconcile provider state for missed/out-of-order callbacks.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Verify provider callbacks and reconcile asynchronously.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Verify provider callbacks and reconcile asynchronously.

rules.title: Separate payment success from order fulfillment until durable confirmation
rules.detail: Fulfillment follows the approved authoritative payment condition and can recover after process restart.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Separate payment success from order fulfillment until durable confirmation.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Separate payment success from order fulfillment until durable confirmation.

rules.title: Maintain auditable monetary records
rules.detail: Store currency, amount, provider reference, business reference, status history and refund/adjustment evidence with fixed-precision monetary types.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Maintain auditable monetary records.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Maintain auditable monetary records.

rules.title: Handle refunds and partial outcomes explicitly
rules.detail: Define permissions, idempotency, partial refund rules and reconciliation for refund/cancel/chargeback cases.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Handle refunds and partial outcomes explicitly.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Handle refunds and partial outcomes explicitly.

integration_guide.title: Resolve capability requirements
integration_guide.description: Link CAP-PAYMENT to the feature/business requirements, applicable platform/technology standards and external provider constraints.

integration_guide.title: Design states, contracts and invariants
integration_guide.description: Define Payments & Billing states, API/data contracts, security rules, failure/retry behavior and acceptance criteria before implementation.

integration_guide.title: Implement through project architecture
integration_guide.description: Apply the capability using the project-selected web/mobile/backend/database technology standards without embedding vendor-specific behavior in unrelated layers.

integration_guide.title: Verify end-to-end scenarios
integration_guide.description: Test happy path, authorization, validation, duplicate/retry, failure/recovery and audit/observability scenarios that apply.

common_issues.issue: Provider charged successfully but order remains unpaid
common_issues.cause: Payment callback and business state were not reconciled durably.
common_issues.solution: Persist provider references/events and run idempotent reconciliation.
Use a stable idempotency key and unique durable business/provider mapping.
